sentences.en: They strengthened the embankments to secure the village against floods.
sentences.zh: 他们加固了堤坝，以防村庄遭受洪水侵袭。

sentences.en: Sami's body was discovered dumped over a highway embankment in Ontario.
sentences.zh: 萨米的尸体被发现丢弃在安大略省的一条高速公路堤岸上。

sentences.en: Blossoms have come out on the embankment.
